sentences.en: In swimming pools, water is continuously pumped through a filter.
sentences.zh: 在游泳池里，水会不断经过过滤器被抽走。

sentences.en: We get our water from a pump in the backyard.
sentences.zh: 我们的水是从后院的一个水泵取得的。

sentences.en: We were really under the pump to meet that deadline.
sentences.zh: 为了按时完成那个截止日期的任务，我们压力很大。

senses.zh: 用泵抽水；快速上下(或内外)运动
